OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'

The full suite is green (the acceptance tests are the only tests in this project). 

## Summary

I implemented required-field validation for `POST /api/owners` so that a request missing or blank in any of `firstName`, `lastName`, `address`, `city`, or `telephone` is rejected with **400** and a body of the form `{"errors": ["city", ...]}` listing every offending field.

Following the project's OfficeFloor function-injection conventions, the work is split into small single-responsibility units:

- **`ValidateOwnerFields`** (new function) — the first step of the POST pipeline. It binds `@RequestBody` (the single body read for the pipeline), checks the five required fields, collects all that are null or blank, and throws a checked `MissingOwnerFieldsException` if any are found. Otherwise it publishes the validated body as `Out<OwnerFieldsDto>` for downstream steps.
- **`BuildOwner`** (updated) — now consumes the validated body via `@Val OwnerFieldsDto` instead of re-binding `@RequestBody`, keeping to the "only one step binds the body" rule.
- **`MissingOwnerFieldsException`** (new checked exception) — carries the list of offending field names.
- **`MissingOwnerFieldsExceptionHandler`** + escalation YAML — responds 400 with the field list.
- **`FieldErrorsResponse`** (new record) — serializes to `{"errors": [...]}`.
- **`owners.POST.yml`** — adds the `validate` step ahead of `build`.

Validating before build also means an invalid body is reported at once (all missing fields together), and blank/whitespace values are treated as missing per the spec.
